title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Installment Plan Length by Payment Record
content:
**Training note — how many installments a lease-end plan starts from, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Rule.** The plan's punctuality installments are 4 (the clean-record installments) when no late charge was ever assessed on the lease, 3 (the one-late installments) when exactly one late charge was assessed on the lease, and 2 when two or more were. The plan's number of installments, by which the plan balance is divided, is built on this count.

*Does a late charge that was later waived count?* Yes. The rule looks at late charges ever assessed on the lease; a waiver does not undo the assessment.

*Does a returned-payment fee count?* No. Only late charges are counted.

| Late charges ever assessed on the lease | Punctuality installments |
|---|---|
| 0 | 4 |
| 1 | 3 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 5 | 2 |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a lease whose history shows one late charge, assessed in its second year and waived as a courtesy, starts its plan from 3 punctuality installments.
